evals.prompt: harness-release — my plugin.json is at version 1.1.0 and I've completed Phase 10 adding the harness-release skill. I want to cut a minor release.
evals.expected_output: Claude reads plugin.json (version 1.1.0), proposes 1.2.0 as the next minor version, runs git log to collect commits since the last tag, groups them into a Keep a Changelog entry (Added/Fixed/Changed), prepends CHANGELOG.md, updates plugin.json to 1.2.0, and prints the GitHub Release checklist with the exact tag and push commands.

assertions.text: Claude reads plugin.json or package.json to determine the current version before proposing a bump
Claude proposes a specific next version number (patch/minor/major) and explains the rationale
A CHANGELOG entry is generated in Keep a Changelog format with grouped commits (Added/Fixed/Changed)
plugin.json version field is updated to the new version
A release checklist is printed with git tag, git push --tags, and gh release create commands

evals.prompt: cut a release — I haven't tagged anything yet. My package.json is at 0.1.0 and I want a patch release.
evals.expected_output: Claude reads package.json version (0.1.0), proposes 0.1.1 (patch), falls back to full git log because no tags exist yet, groups commits into a CHANGELOG entry, prepends or creates CHANGELOG.md, updates package.json to 0.1.1, and prints the checklist including git tag v0.1.1.

assertions.text: When no git tags exist, Claude falls back to the full git log instead of failing
Claude proposes the correct patch bump (0.1.0 → 0.1.1)
If CHANGELOG.md does not exist, Claude creates it with the new entry as the first release
A release checklist is printed with exact commands for tagging and publishing

evals.prompt: prepare a release — I want to tag this version but there are still two cc:TODO tasks left in phase-3.
evals.expected_output: Claude warns the user that incomplete tasks remain in the active phase, lists the cc:TODO tasks by number and description, and asks for explicit confirmation before proceeding with the release preparation.

assertions.text: Claude detects and warns about cc:TODO tasks remaining in the active phase before proceeding
The warning includes the specific task numbers and descriptions that are not yet done
Claude asks the user to confirm they want to proceed with an incomplete phase before writing any files
